presets.name: Motor imagery

channelPresets.label: Central ring (C5, C3, C1, Cz, C2, C4, C6, CP3, CPz, CP4, FC3, FCz, FC4)

hints.page2: Motor imagery effects usually start about 0.5 s after the cue.
hints.page3: Motor imagery lives over the motor strip (C3, Cz, C4).
hints.page4: Mu (8-12 Hz) and beta (13-30 Hz) power drop during imagery.

presets.facts: Motor imagery causes event-related desynchronization (ERD, a drop in mu 8-12 Hz and beta 13-30 Hz power) over the sensorimotor cortex contralateral to the imagined hand, so left-hand imagery is strongest at C4 and right-hand imagery at C3.

presets.name: P300 / ERP

channelPresets.label: Parietal-occipital (Pz, P3, P4, PO7, PO8, Oz)

hints.page2: The P300 response peaks about 0.3 to 0.5 s after the stimulus.
hints.page3: Midline central and parietal sites (Cz, Pz) carry the P300.
hints.page4: Most ERP energy is below about 12 Hz.

presets.facts: Rare target stimuli evoke a positive deflection about 300 to 500 ms after onset (P300), largest over midline central and parietal sites (Cz, Pz).

presets.name: SSVEP

hints.page2: The response builds up over the first few hundred milliseconds.
hints.page3: Occipital sites (O1, Oz, O2) carry the response.
hints.page4: Look for peaks at the stimulus frequency and its second harmonic.

presets.facts: A flickering visual stimulus at frequency f evokes a response at f and its harmonics over occipital sites.

families.title: Windowed means (ERP-style)
families.formula: m_j = mean of x over bin j (bin width w ms); optional baseline: x - mean(x over baseline)
families.explanation: Average amplitude in consecutive short time bins of the window.

band_power.title: Band power
band_power.formula: P = integral of the Welch PSD over [f_lo, f_hi] (trapezoid), uV^2
band_power.explanation: How much signal energy each channel has inside chosen frequency bands.

csp.title: CSP (spatial filters)
csp.formula: w = argmax (w' C_a w) / (w' C_b w); feature = log(var(w' x)), fitted on training folds only
csp.explanation: Learned channel mixtures whose variance differs most between classes.

hjorth.title: Hjorth parameters
hjorth.formula: activity = var(x); mobility = sqrt(var(x')/var(x)); complexity = mobility(x')/mobility(x)
hjorth.explanation: Activity, mobility and complexity: variance and how fast the signal changes.

wavelet.title: Wavelet energy
wavelet.formula: E(f) = mean over the window of |CWT_morlet(x)(f, t)|^2 (pywt.cwt, cmor), uV^2
wavelet.explanation: Energy at several frequencies from a complex Morlet wavelet transform.

covariance.title: Covariance (Riemannian)
covariance.formula: C = cov(x) (OAS or SCM, pyriemann Covariances); s = TangentSpace(C) about the training-fold mean
covariance.explanation: How channels vary together, mapped to a flat tangent space for linear classifiers.

time_stats.title: Time-domain statistics
time_stats.formula: variance = mean((x - mean)^2) (ddof=0); RMS = sqrt(mean(x^2)); line length = sum|diff(x)|; kurtosis = excess (Gaussian = 0); Higuchi FD = slope of log L(k) vs log(1/k), k = 1..kmax
time_stats.explanation: Simple numbers per channel: mean, spread, size and shape of the waveform.

window_means.title: Windowed means (ERP-style)
window_means.formula: m_j = mean of x over bin j (bin width w ms); optional baseline: x - mean(x over baseline)
window_means.explanation: Average amplitude in consecutive short time bins of the window.

spectral_features.title: Spectral descriptors
spectral_features.formula: Welch PSD, nperseg = min(round(sfreq), n_samples), 50% overlap; band power = trapezoid integral; relative = band / reference band; entropy = -sum(p log p)/log(n_pos); centroid = sum(f P)/sum(P); peak = argmax P in the reference band; ratio = P_num / (P_den + 1e-12)
spectral_features.note: frequency resolution is limited by the window length
spectral_features.explanation: Shape of the power spectrum: band powers, peak, centroid and entropy.

tf_regions.title: Time-frequency regions
tf_regions.interval: task 0.250 to 0.600 s, 1-12 Hz; baseline -0.200 to 0.000 s (original full epoch)
tf_regions.formula: P(f,t) = |CWT(x_bandpassed_full_epoch)|^2; mean/max/energy over the rectangle; % change = 100 (P_task - P_baseline) / P_baseline
tf_regions.explanation: Power inside a chosen time and frequency rectangle, and its change from baseline.

asymmetry.title: Hemispheric asymmetry
asymmetry.formula: diff = P_left - P_right; normalized = (P_left - P_right) / (P_left + P_right + 1e-12)
asymmetry.explanation: Difference in band power between matched left and right channels.

complexity.title: Signal complexity
complexity.formula: line length = sum|diff(x)|; Higuchi FD = slope of log L(k) vs log(1/k), k = 1..kmax
complexity.explanation: How jagged and self-similar the signal is (line length, Higuchi fractal dimension).

autoencoder.title: Learned latent features (advanced)
autoencoder.formula: h = tanh(W1 z + b1), z = standardized decimated trial; x_hat = W2 h + b2; minimize mean (x_hat - z)^2
autoencoder.explanation: A tiny network learns a compressed code of each trial (trained on training folds only).
